WORKFORCE / SEASONAL AND ISLANDS

Staff rooms for
the busy season.

For resorts, park concessioners and island employers.

Furnished private rooms with their own bath, from park gateway towns to island resorts. Raised on ground screws, and removable when no longer needed.

Start a conversationSee the units

THE PROBLEM

Employers are building their own staff housing.

Staff arrive all at once, and the rentals go to visitors. For a seasonal employer, a room near the work is how the roster gets filled.

WHERE IT FITS

From park gateways to island resorts.

Islands
Ground screws keep every floor level on a slope. Climate packages for hot, humid and storm-prone sites.
Parks
Gateway towns and concession operations with summer staff surges.
Coastal
Beach and resort towns where staff housing has to come out when it is no longer needed.
Rooms
Private rooms, or the shared layout with two twin beds and one bath for seasonal crews.

OPERATING MODEL

Three ways to run it.

  • Own

    Own it for your staff

    House seasonal and year-round staff on your own land, close to the work.

  • Lease

    Lease from an operator

    An operator owns the cluster and leases rooms, or the whole cluster, to you.

  • Grow

    Start small

    Place a few units on land you own, then add a cluster before next season.

Sale or lease terms are set per project. Units are built to be moved when needs change.

THE UNITS

One shell family.
Built for crews and staff.

Every market on this page uses Outpost: private rooms with a factory-built bath pod and a kitchenette, on the same 4 ft wall module. Mix the layouts in one cluster.

Single or shared roomOne person, or two in twin beds, with one bath pod.Two private roomsTwo lockable rooms in one unit, each with its own bath pod.Accessible roomRoll-in bath pod and a steel ramp to the door.
